spans.s:
sakhyabhakti
(‘devotion [to God] as a friend’)
------------------------------------------
Bhakti or devotion to God, can assume several forms. The Nārada भक्ति-sūtras, a well-known treatise on भक्ति, describes eleven such modes (sūtra 82). The sixth mode in this series is called ‘sakhyāsakti,’ same as सख्यभक्ति.
It denotes love of God as one’s dear friend. अर्जुन, उद्धव, सुदाम (or कुचेल) and the cowherd boys of Vṛndābana are quoted as the classic examples. The Bhagavadgītā (11.41, 42) reflects this idea very well.
See also BHAKTI.
